mechanism: Use one clearly adult original selfie carrier as the identity anchor across a rapid native-phone montage in one coherent gathering. Alternate short activity inserts with repeated returns to the carrier, and let the visible group grow in countable stages: setup, task, arrivals, peak collective reaction and complete shared gesture. Preserve recurring environmental anchors, ordinary jump cuts, slight shake, focus breathing and late recentering without losing the carrier. End on the largest readable group state and one completed communal action. The reusable mechanism is selfie anchor, activity proof, progressive group growth, imperfect phone grammar and terminal communal gesture—not the source woman, face, sports clothing, stadium, parking lot, car trunks, grills, burgers, drinks, team gear, friends, exact prompt, timing, creator identity or model label.

invariants.rule: Keep one clearly adult original selfie carrier recognizable across every phase.
invariants.purpose: Provides identity continuity through rapid cuts.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing the carrier turns the sequence into an unrelated compilation.

invariants.rule: Stay within one coherent gathering and repeat at least two environmental anchors.
invariants.purpose: Makes jump cuts read as one event.

invariants.rule: Alternate activity proof with returns to the carrier rather than showing only faces.
invariants.purpose: Answers what the group is doing and why it grows.
invariants.ablation_failure: A face-only montage lacks causal event progression.

invariants.rule: Increase the readable group state through at least three stages while retaining natural imperfect phone behavior.
invariants.purpose: Builds social escalation without staged coverage.
invariants.ablation_failure: A constant group or polished stabilization flattens the candid arc.

invariants.rule: End on the largest group state and one complete shared action.
invariants.purpose: Provides a countable terminal memory payoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending mid-pan or before the gesture leaves the event unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman's likeness, hair, clothing, smile, gestures and exact selfie angles
the source stadium parking lot, car trunks, coolers, grills, burgers, drinks and sports gear
the source friends, team identities, group arrangement, cheers, high-fives and toast timing
the source rapid-cut order, camera shake pattern, focus changes, exposure and color treatment
the source creator identity, exact prompt wording, Seedance 2.0 claim, platform overlay, watermark and branding
